subject: ethics
subject_name: Professional Ethics and Professional Accounting System
summary: The exam paper follows a highly consistent structural pattern, divided into Part A short-answer questions (worth 6 marks) and Part B essay-style long-answer questions (worth 16 marks). Dominant recurring themes include professional misconduct and disciplinary committees, duties of advocates towards clients, courts, and society, as well as accounting for lawyers and Bar-Bench relations. Long essays heavily prioritize the structural powers of Bar Councils, ethical duties, and legal accounting rules, while short notes frequently test procedural topics like enrolment, legal aid, and disqualifications.
